description: Structured compatibility metadata layered over the COMPAT.md matrices. Matrix rows remain the human-facing contract; scripts/compat/ledger.ts derives the full ledger and applies this overlay for conformance checks and explicit exceptions.

conformanceChecks.guards: push() under denying rules mints a 20-char dash-prefixed key and returns a thenable (no sync throw, no key loss).
increment() is implemented and starts from 0 against a missing field.
the modular DataSnapshot exposes size / priority / exportVal() (not the legacy numChildren()).
getDocs/query reads enforce security rules — a denied query throws permission-denied (no silent bypass).

observationExceptions.rtdb-onvalue-fires-on-set: Upstream listener-shape observation for the agent-tool deny-list; it intentionally references the deny-listed listener family rather than a single implemented matrix row.
observationExceptions.rtdb-servertimestamp-resolves: Upstream sentinel-shape observation for the agent-tool deny-list; it intentionally references the deny-listed sentinel family rather than a single implemented matrix row.
observationExceptions.rtdb-modular-orderbyvalue-numeric: Prod rejected the query because the oracle project lacked the required .indexOn; the observation documents index enforcement rather than a directly matching matrix row.
observationExceptions.rtdb-modular-onchildmoved-with-orderby: Locks ordered-query child_moved upstream shape while the current matrix row documents the plain-ref no-fire sandbox behavior.
